description:
Zensus 2022 household data for Berlin. Source: Statistisches Bundesamt, Zensus 2022.

Without a category: total number of households.
With a category:
- groesse: household size (1 person, 2 persons, etc.)
- wohndauer: length of residence (under 1 year, 1-5 years, etc.)

Parameters:
- rbs: "stadt" (city) | "bezirk" (Borough) | "stadtteil" | "ortsteil" (District) | "planungsraum" (Neighborhood, LOR Planungsraum)
- kategorie: "groesse" | "wohndauer" (optional)
- bezirk_id, stadtteil_id, ortsteil_id, planungsraum_id: geographic filters
- start/end, recent, limit, fields, include: "metadata"
name: socio_berlin_census_households
title: Census Households
